title: The 38 leftover test Pencils leave the owner's Space, and a Pencil whose dates have all passed folds out of the live Plans

source.ref: Plans and calendar clarity audit 2026-11-25 (project thread: Audit the project and calendar system; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/GUTHmChGkqaEmPSRUdzJHz)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-25 in production: 38 of the 39 live Plans on /spaces/danieltyack are titled 'Browser pencil <timestamp>-<id>', dated Sep 22 to 24. They come from test/e2e/operator-calendar.spec.ts run against production in September; its afterEach cleanup (HYG-120) archives through the UI and missed these, likely runs from before the cleanup or ones that failed mid-test. None carries hold_until, so the hold sweep would never clear them. They fill the rail's Plans list, the Plans views and Work's Live Plans. Fix: the 38 test Plans are archived (reversible: archived_at), and a pure past-Pencil check folds any Pencil whose every date has passed out of Work and the Plans views.

DONE 2026-11-25: lib/calendar/past-pencil.ts isPastPencil is the one rule. The calendar board (lib/calendar/planner/board.ts) labels such a Pencil 'Date passed' and sinks it below the live Pencils; Console Work reads every Pencil date (listPlanPencilDays) and leaves them out of Live Plans, saying how many it left out. The 38 test Plans on danieltyack are archived by a paste-ready SQL file for the owner (/mnt/project-files/pm-audit/ARCHIVE-browser-pencils-danieltyack.sql), since the agent cannot write production rows.

verify.note: Passes while Work and the Plans board both apply the past-Pencil rule.
